displayName: Enable Follow service in Microsoft Edge (Obsolete)
description:
Lets Microsoft Edge browser enable Follow service and apply it to users.

Users can use the Follow feature for an influencer, site, or topic in Microsoft Edge.

If you enable or don't configure this policy, Follow in Microsoft Edge is applied.

If you disable this policy, Microsoft Edge won't communicate with Follow service to provide the follow feature.

This policy is obsolete after version 126.
